title: A settings panel shows the previous account

initial_facts.text: A user switches the settings panel from account A to account B.
The panel keeps account A’s details visible while account B loads.

public_evidence.text: Only one request for account B was issued and its response completed successfully.
The response contains account B's current details.
The client cache key is settings:current-user and is reused when the selected account changes.
Switching accounts does not invalidate or replace the cached settings entry; the panel reads that entry before the response is applied.

accepted_alternatives: Diagnose client cache identity/invalidation as supported; distinguish it from response-order races.
Ask for the request count, response value, and cache key before deciding.
Use account identity in the key and clear or revalidate on account switch, with a regression test.
